decision: Estate-wide destination accepted; canonical IDL and transport selection gated on EC-00 architectural qualification

activities.title: Inventory every estate interface and assign migration disposition
activities.scope: Build producer/consumer/version/authority inventory from source plus owner observations; include internal APIs, CLI machine modes, MCP mappings, events, artifacts, plugins and scripts. Record replace/adapt/retain-external/retire per boundary; unknown consumers block retirement. Reconcile smaller projects and generated guidance.

activities.title: Qualify architecture alternatives and record the stack decision
activities.scope: Use the landed architectural discovery to compare protobuf plus gRPC/Connect against TypeSpec/OpenAPI and scoped alternatives on identical operator-action cases. Record actual language/runtime/browser/proxy behavior, failure semantics, tooling burden and benchmarks. Select IDL, transports, versions and exception rules through an ADR before foundation implementation; estate-wide rewrite remains committed.

activities.title: Define canonical domain contract foundation and package ownership
activities.scope: Implement selected IDL package boundaries, identifiers, commands/queries/events, validation, compatibility policy, authority metadata, semantic hashing and domain ownership. Settle operator-request ownership with OA-01. No generic execute-payload escape or new universal runtime.

activities.title: Build reproducible contract generation and conformance toolchain
activities.scope: Generate typed clients, validators, readable CLI/MCP schemas, fixtures and docs from one source; pin compiler/plugins/runtime matrix; test deterministic regeneration and lossy projections; package versioned artifacts for Python/TypeScript and discovered Go/Rust consumers.

activities.title: Migrate service composition and client transport contracts
activities.scope: Replace internal service/client/adapter-kit/schema-runtime interfaces with selected contracts; preserve compatibility discovery, context/knowledge, artifacts, effect and learning semantics. Qualify streaming, errors, pagination, overload, resumable reads and capability negotiation.

activities.title: Migrate work, request, release and continuation provider boundary
activities.scope: Map reference work provider operations and durable identifiers; preserve CAS, reservations, terminal decisions, snapshots and cross-project dependencies. Implement operator request/continuation requirements with OA-01/OA-04 under settled ownership; qualify alternative provider conformance.

activities.title: Migrate identity delegation and protected-operation interfaces
activities.scope: Adapt broker identity/session/capability APIs and protected consumers while retaining existing authentication, custody and policy owners. Verify spoofing, audience/resource scope, revocation, replay, unknown fields and exact-operation binding; no automatic grant widening.

activities.title: Migrate evidence ingestion and reconstruction interfaces
activities.scope: Replace publisher/ingest/query boundaries while preserving original event IDs, bytes, provenance, observation-vs-decision semantics and S4 authoritative home. Introduce versioned decoding and semantic signature/digest test vectors; no historical evidence restamping.

activities.title: Migrate hosted edge and prove operator-action vertical workflow
activities.scope: Implement chosen browser/HTTP/RPC edge and adapters, tenant isolation and generated UI clients; compose OA-01 through OA-06 as first end-to-end consumer. Preserve protected-side pull topology and distinct hosting/effect grants; verify actual proxy and browser paths.

activities.title: Migrate native runtime integrations and generated agent tools
activities.scope: Replace Claude/Codex/local-native integration plumbing using generated readable tools; map provider work/session handles without pretending all providers support wake, cancel, tools or events. Qualify lost delivery, dead sessions and successor continuation; retain external native protocols at adapters.

activities.title: Qualify deployment networking telemetry and disaster recovery
activities.scope: Update service discovery, ingress/proxy/timeouts, identity, observability, deployment compatibility and backup/restore composition; test network faults and outage recovery using disposable environments before any separately authorized live rollout.

activities.title: Package generated SDK toolchains and workstation integrations
activities.scope: Pin compiler/plugins/client runtimes in reproducible host packaging; exercise rebuild/offline restore, certificate/config discovery and user terminal integrations. Avoid a mandatory extra runtime or language without measured justification.

activities.title: Migrate compute-provider and capacity observation interfaces
activities.scope: Adapt resource discovery, provisioned compute handles, cost/usage and teardown observations through typed contracts; preserve missingness, provider-native APIs and region/retention boundaries. Bulk data remains in suitable referenced artifact formats.

activities.title: Migrate inference integration and local resource metadata
activities.scope: Adapt local model/harness/tool/environment metadata and native client integration; retain external inference protocol; verify context/privacy refusal, interruption, contention and rollback without introducing central model routing.

activities.title: Migrate household publication and outcome integration
activities.scope: Use generated contracts for commitment/publication/outcome references and freshness corrections; preserve household authority, evidence windows, human decisions and raw-data locality. Validate representative actual consumer workflows and export.

activities.title: Migrate writing context and ratified outcome integration
activities.scope: Replace machine boundaries for context/artifact/work/outcome links while preserving human creative ratification and source revisions; prove interruption, correction, export and no automatic canon promotion.

activities.title: Migrate physical and cooperative project integrations
activities.scope: Map project evidence, work and physical/human attestation boundaries; preserve domain-specific authority and uncertain physical outcomes; prove supported workflows and failure recovery with generated clients.

activities.title: Migrate research evidence and decision integrations
activities.scope: Map research sources, assumptions, provenance, evidence and accepted decisions without converting estimates into facts; preserve corpus revisions and export; qualify old/new client behavior and useful domain outcomes.

activities.title: Migrate browser workspace and runtime adapter boundaries
activities.scope: Generate supported browser and local bridge interfaces; qualify Python/TypeScript/Rust boundaries actually present, browser streaming restrictions, identity, cancellation and result links; retain browser/runtime-owned execution.

activities.title: Reconcile remaining consumers and retire obsolete integration surfaces
activities.scope: Account for Bindery and every smaller tool/plugin/script found by EC-01, including historical kctl/actionq/outctl surfaces. Assign owner-specific implementation tasks before cutover; prove replace/adapt/external-retain/retire disposition. Retired components are not rebuilt merely because old schemas exist.

activities.title: Run estate conformance recovery and supplier replacement campaign
activities.scope: Run mixed-version/language/transport matrices and negative cases, operator overnight scenario, domain outcomes, whole-system recovery and actual provider swap. Measure bounded performance, maintenance and attention against baseline; no throughput benefit inferred from encoding.

activities.title: Close migration and delete superseded internal interfaces
activities.scope: Verify every inventoried boundary reaches target or an explicit retained external exception; remove temporary shims, duplicate schemas/endpoints/clients/configuration/docs, prove no hidden consumers, retain evidence/history and recovery assets. Record removal PRs and source/released/deployed/qualified distinctions.

requirements.requirement: Every internal machine interface has a unique inventory entry and explicit disposition.
requirements.acceptance: Reconcile repository discovery, configured deployments and observed consumers; unresolved/unknown entries prevent programme completion.

requirements.requirement: Select one estate-wide canonical contract-authoring convention, with one source per domain package, after architecture qualification.
requirements.acceptance: ADR compares shortlist on mandatory cases; no independently edited generated schemas; selected versions and exclusions are explicit.

requirements.requirement: Package and service boundaries follow domain state and authority ownership.
requirements.acceptance: Ownership/import graph is acyclic; work, evidence, authority and UI responsibilities remain distinct; no generic execute(type,payload) authority bypass.

requirements.requirement: Work, request, attempt, artifact, event and provider-reference identities remain stable and separately typed.
requirements.acceptance: A cross-provider continuation retains work identity while changing attempt; tenant/repository collisions and wrong-kind IDs are rejected.

requirements.requirement: Missing, zero, empty, unknown, denied and unavailable retain distinct semantics across projections.
requirements.acceptance: Cross-language and JSON/binary tests exercise defaults, presence, unknown enums/fields, oneof/unions, nullability, integers beyond JS safe range, decimals, timestamps and bytes.

requirements.requirement: Business constraints and operation preconditions are enforced by owners beyond generated type checks.
requirements.acceptance: Well-typed invalid scope/range/state transitions fail; generated validators match server behavior and errors do not leak secrets.

requirements.requirement: Compatibility covers source clients, wire data, readable/tool projections and business behavior.
requirements.acceptance: Supported N/N-1 matrix is declared and passes; incompatible changes require a new version and rollout; removed field identities are never reused where applicable.

requirements.requirement: Compilers, plugins, descriptors and packages are pinned, reproducible and independently verifiable.
requirements.acceptance: Clean builds regenerate byte-identical generated artifacts under declared environment; tampered plugin/artifact fails; clients install offline from retained artifacts.

requirements.requirement: CLI/MCP and model-facing schemas derive from canonical contracts while staying readable and bounded.
requirements.acceptance: Same valid/invalid fixtures pass/fail across surfaces; unsupported schema constructs fail generation explicitly; no handwritten semantic shadow interface.

requirements.requirement: Transport selection meets native, browser, proxy and local connection requirements without separate semantics.
requirements.acceptance: Representative requests/events traverse actual supported ingress patterns; HTTP/JSON/gRPC/Connect alternatives are qualified only where selected.

requirements.requirement: Queries define pagination, consistency, freshness and permission-scoped snapshots.
requirements.acceptance: Concurrent mutation, expired cursor, revoked access and unavailable source produce explicit outcomes; no cross-tenant cursor leakage.

requirements.requirement: Errors distinguish validation, stale revision, denial, unsupported capability, outage, limit and unknown effect.
requirements.acceptance: Clients map typed errors consistently; transient failure is not absence; retry guidance never blindly repeats an uncertain effect.

requirements.requirement: Mutations use expected revisions and scoped idempotency with declared retention.
requirements.acceptance: Concurrent writers conflict; retry of identical operation returns original result; reused key with different payload fails; expired-key handling is explicit.

requirements.requirement: Events have stable IDs, ordering scope, cursors, deduplication and replay/reset semantics.
requirements.acceptance: Disconnect/restart/duplicate/out-of-order/compacted cursor tests pass; resume cannot silently skip events; event delivery is not exactly-once effect execution.

requirements.requirement: Deadlines, cancellation and retries are explicit per operation.
requirements.acceptance: Timeout after commit yields reconcilable unknown effect; cancellation is not assumed rollback; non-idempotent effects are not automatically retried or hedged.

requirements.requirement: Bound payloads, queues, concurrency, streams and resource consumption with backpressure.
requirements.acceptance: Slow client, oversized message, decompression expansion and overload tests remain bounded; recovery does not cause retry storms.

requirements.requirement: Clients negotiate capabilities and supported contract versions without treating advertising as authority.
requirements.acceptance: Unsupported wake/stream/tool modes fail visibly; old clients cannot interpret unknown success states or gain scope through negotiation.

requirements.requirement: Authenticated transport identity is bound to actual principal, audience, workspace, resource and action.
requirements.acceptance: Spoofed identity fields/forwarded headers, wrong audience and cross-tenant requests are denied by the owner; payload identity creates no grant.

requirements.requirement: Delegation, revocation and exact-operation acceptance survive the interface migration.
requirements.acceptance: Expired/revoked/wrong-target/replayed grants fail; altered artifact or procedure cannot reuse acceptance; authority checks occur at the protected boundary.

requirements.requirement: Public coordination never gains a new push path into the protected horizon.
requirements.acceptance: Topology and negative tests prove protected consumers pull under local authority; generated clients cannot bypass existing custody/egress boundaries.

requirements.requirement: Logs, messages, diagnostics and exports enforce redaction, retention and owner entitlements.
requirements.acceptance: Secret fixtures and unauthorized workspace records are absent from tool/UI/trace outputs; deleted/revoked data behavior is specified and verified.

requirements.requirement: Signed or hashed meaning uses a versioned domain-specific representation, not generic serialization determinism.
requirements.acceptance: Cross-language golden vectors cover map order, unknown fields, numeric edge cases and schema changes; altered meaning invalidates binding; original signed bytes remain retained.

requirements.requirement: Historical evidence identity, provenance and authoritative home remain intact.
requirements.acceptance: Old records decode using retained schemas, retain original bytes/digests, and link to transformed views; reconciliation never restamps historical observations.

requirements.requirement: Bulk artifacts use authorized immutable references, integrity checks and bounded transfer contracts.
requirements.acceptance: Expired/unauthorized references fail; corruption is detected; large files are not forced into oversized control messages; portable export reconstructs references.

requirements.requirement: The OA-01–OA-06 operator-action lifecycle is the first complete consumer of the selected foundation.
requirements.acceptance: Both runtimes publish current procedures; dead/shared/stale/partial requests and verification/attestation cases pass; TUI works without reopening chat.

requirements.requirement: Resolution continues only affected work through supported native runtime mechanisms.
requirements.acceptance: Duplicate delivery does not repeat operations; successor uses exact evidence; unsupported wake shows continuation-ready; no new estate scheduler.

requirements.requirement: Reference work-provider settlement and cross-project links retain semantics.
requirements.acceptance: Reservations, releases, CAS and terminal decisions pass existing and new conformance; source receipt/completion event never substitutes for acceptance.

requirements.requirement: Context, knowledge, source corrections and permissions use versioned typed references.
requirements.acceptance: Correction invalidates affected conclusions only; source/permission changes are visible; model confidence is not context authority.

requirements.requirement: Outcome comparisons preserve cost, attention, denominator, uncertainty and revision provenance.
requirements.acceptance: Missing observations remain unknown; comparable cohorts reconstruct accepted outcomes; no model router or compiled agent profile is recreated.

requirements.requirement: Browser/TUI and hosted services use shared contracts with explicit tenancy and supported transport modes.
requirements.acceptance: Wrong tenant, browser reconnect, proxy buffering and authentication expiry tests pass; UI state cannot settle protected work.

requirements.requirement: Deployment, discovery, ingress, health, telemetry and restore support mixed-version migration.
requirements.acceptance: Disposable rollout/drain/rollback and whole-application restore prove configured RPO/RTO and retained decoding assets before live promotion.

requirements.requirement: Host packages reproduce supported compiler/client/runtime and local integration configurations.
requirements.acceptance: Clean rebuild and offline recovery pass; supported versions are explicit; no hidden developer workstation dependency remains.

requirements.requirement: Compute/capacity/cost observations map through typed adapters while providers retain native APIs.
requirements.acceptance: Scope/region/retention, missing utilization and teardown results remain explicit; provisioning observation does not imply resource ownership or permission.

requirements.requirement: Local inference boundaries preserve qualified arrangement metadata and privacy constraints.
requirements.acceptance: Refused local-only data never falls through to cloud; engine/parser/model revisions, context/concurrency and fallback remain measurable.

requirements.requirement: Household commitment/publication/outcome interfaces preserve domain meaning.
requirements.acceptance: Corrected source windows supersede appropriate evidence; estimates differ from measured effects; human acceptance and raw-data locality remain intact.

requirements.requirement: Creative workspace integration preserves source revisions and human canon ratification.
requirements.acceptance: Generated client can resume/export/correct work without silent canon promotion; original artifacts and acceptance remain reconstructible.

requirements.requirement: Physical/cooperative outcomes retain explicit attestation and uncertainty.
requirements.acceptance: Human-performed steps, unknown physical state and accepted evidence are distinguishable across restart and export.

requirements.requirement: Research evidence/decision boundaries retain assumptions and source provenance.
requirements.acceptance: Correction, source version, missing data and accepted decision survive migration and export without converting hypotheses into facts.

requirements.requirement: Browser/local bridge adapters preserve native execution and qualified language interoperability.
requirements.acceptance: Actual Python/TS/Rust surfaces discovered are exercised with cancellation, auth loss, streaming limits and exact result links.

requirements.requirement: Smaller tools, plugins, batch jobs and scripts receive explicit owner migration or retirement decisions.
requirements.acceptance: Bindery and every inventory-discovered consumer have owner tasks before cutover; zero unexplained legacy callers after a declared observation window.

requirements.requirement: Each cutover has one authoritative writer, data reconciliation, consumer switch, rollback and adapter expiry.
requirements.acceptance: Fault injection during each stage does not create competing authorities; rollback handles new records and unsupported old clients; no indefinite shim.

requirements.requirement: Transport changes do not silently change persistence contracts or erase retention obligations.
requirements.acceptance: Storage migration is separately justified and tested; backups retain schemas/keys by existing policy; restored historical records retain meaning.

requirements.requirement: Performance and reliability claims use representative predeclared workloads and baselines.
requirements.acceptance: Report p50/p95 latency, CPU/RSS, payload size, reconnect/load behavior, generation/build time, maintenance effort and sample size; no fabricated speedup.

requirements.requirement: Conformance spans languages, versions, transports, domain behavior and injected faults.
requirements.acceptance: Supported matrix passes all mandatory negatives; a deliberately broken schema/authority/replay case fails the gate; real supplier swap and recovery are demonstrated.

requirements.requirement: Humans can inspect typed traffic and reconstruct failures without exposing private payloads.
requirements.acceptance: Readable redacted CLI views and trace IDs reconstruct requests/results/evidence; debug replay is isolated and cannot execute live effects.

requirements.requirement: Rewrite completion requires removal of superseded internal paths and explicit retained external boundaries.
requirements.acceptance: Inventory has no unresolved entries; removal PRs, consumer evidence, release/deployment observations and support/rollback/export handover are linked.

requirements.requirement: Selected dependencies have viable licensing, maintenance, offline builds and upgrade/security response.
requirements.acceptance: Document version/runtime support and provenance; pin artifacts; rehearse upgrade/rollback; no required paid registry or hosted code generator without explicit sourcing decision.

requirements.requirement: Estate rewrite remains accountable to useful outcomes and maintenance/attention burden.
requirements.acceptance: Measure workflow success, repeated prompts, stale requests, cost per accepted cohort and interface maintenance before/after; inconclusive evidence stays inconclusive.
